title: Fire Child
about: “Fire child sing, fire child dance, fire child you'll be mine — light streaming, light streaming, making my fire child glow.” A fire-circle invocation printed in six books of the collection — a circle chant from the Sun Bear Tribe medicine-wheel gatherings, known through Gila Antara's recording on Starchild (1997). The melody here follows her recording.
